title: KS-655: Go-ahead to fix the KS-78 drift check in the launcher across all 16 copies?
bluf: The KS-78 drift check at the start of each session is wrong three ways: it counts HEAD but prints 'main'; it anchors on container start time, not image build time; and it anchors on a stock redis image. On the day it printed 7 commits of drift, 212 existed (ticket measurement). Two sessions ignored a true warning. Launch_Claude.command is boot-path for every session, is not under version control, and there are 16 copies across the workspace, so fixing one fixes one of sixteen. No edit made; the ticket says the fleet-wide fix is carried on the WED board gated on your go-ahead.

options.detail: One consistent fix; ticket acceptance: named branch, build-time baseline, infra images ignored. Each project's own seat applies the fix to its launcher on a brief from Wednesday (Wednesday edits no other project's files).
